description: young man archer in a winter outfit for the old Slavic midwinter feast, lean, short brown hair, standing in the middle of the image, small full body figure from the top of the head to the feet, empty space above the head and below the feet, a fitted brown sheepskin coat with a fleece-lined hood down on the shoulders and red and blue folk embroidery, a fur hat with ear flaps, a green wool scarf, leather bracers and fur-topped boots, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on the back, holding a curved wooden bow with a sprig of fir tied to it, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same face, eyes and big head size as this character
